messages.subject: Errors found with running specific GENEActiv bin files
parts:
Hi all,

I was running the GGIR analysis (1.10-7) for a batch of GENEActiv bin files and errors came up for a few data files (7) where no output was produced. I tried to re-run the analyses for these particular files and the same errors came up (see below). I looked into the meta files folder and noticed that not all meta files were produced for each ms2 to ms5.out (although the basic folder contains all 7 files). Could anyone please advise me what could be the errors and perhaps the solution too?
I have attached the meta files along with the config.csv here for reference. Thanks!!!

Link to access metafiles: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1mRJym7fa7QvyZkVm_OlXX50vtCowbQ-I
